videos.title: Four Froggies: Catch Jimmy All the Way to the Moon
videos.description: When Jimmy zooms off on his jetpack with a secret golden orb, James, Bubbles and Rexy blast off in the Starship to catch him, past Mars, King Germy's crystal caves and Jupiter's icy moon, all the way to a bouncy moon buggy chase on the Moon. A 14-minute animated adventure for kids about friendship, space and real moon physics.

videos.title: Four Froggies: Catch Jimmy All the Way to the Moon (Version 2)
videos.description: Version 2: a shorter, tighter retelling. Jimmy's new jetpack sends him zooming off across the solar system, and James, Bubbles and Rexy chase him from Mars to Callisto to the Moon, with Purple Bear guiding them by phone, until all four froggies fly home together.

videos.title: Four Froggies – Come Home! (Version 3)
videos.description: Version 3: Jimmy grabs the golden orb and his new jetpack rockets him into space, so James, Bubbles and Rexy blast off in the Starship with Commander Spotty and the ranch dogs Germy and Daisy to bring him home. From Mars and King Germy's crystal caves to icy Callisto and a moon buggy rescue on the Moon, they keep calling "Jimmy! Come home!" until all four froggies fly home together.

videos.title: Four Froggies – Come Home! (Version 4)
videos.description: Version 4: Jimmy jetpacks into space, and James, Bubbles and Rexy chase him with Commander Spotty — waving to astronauts Alex and Fred, playing with King Germy and Daisy on Mars, then icy Callisto and a moon buggy rescue on the Moon, before racing home for hammocks.
